DUPLICATE_PHONE: A customer with this phone number already exists. Use the existing profile instead of creating a new one.
INCOMPLETE_ORDER: This order cannot be finalised: every item needs a service type, and at least one item is required.
TAG_IN_USE: This tag number is already assigned to an open order and cannot be reused.
MISSING_DAMAGE_NOTE: A note or photo is required when flagging pre-existing damage.
CANNOT_CANCEL_PROCESSING: This order cannot be cancelled because processing has already started on one or more items. Ask the Branch Manager to review it.
SLOT_FULL: This time slot is fully booked. Please choose another slot.
INCOMPATIBLE_BATCH: This item's service type or fabric category doesn't match this batch. Add it to a compatible batch instead.
STAGE_OUT_OF_SEQUENCE: This stage cannot be completed before it has been started.
MACHINE_UNAVAILABLE: This machine is currently in use or under maintenance and cannot be assigned.
MISSING_REWORK_REASON: A reason is required before this item can be sent for rework.
QC_NOT_PASSED: This item cannot be packaged: it has not recorded a Pass outcome from quality control.
RESOLUTION_REQUIRED: This damage report cannot be closed without a recorded resolution.
INCOMPLETE_MANIFEST: This order cannot be marked Packaged: one or more items on the manifest are not yet checked off.
PAYMENT_OUTSTANDING: This order cannot be marked Collected: payment is still outstanding. Process payment first, or apply a recorded credit exception.
ROUTE_AT_CAPACITY: This route is already at its configured maximum number of orders. Assign this order to a different route or time window.
POD_REQUIRED: A signature or photo is required before this order can be marked Delivered.
NO_PRICE_CONFIGURED: This item category and service type combination has no configured price. Configure a price before this item can be added to an order.
PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: A reference number is required for card or mobile money payments before this transaction can be recorded.
REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT: This refund amount exceeds what was actually paid on this order and cannot be processed.
CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This order would exceed the corporate account's credit limit. A Branch Manager override is required to proceed.
VARIANCE_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The counted amount differs from the expected amount by {{amount}}. This cash-up has been sent to the Branch Manager for review.
AUDIT_IMMUTABLE: Audit records cannot be edited or deleted. To correct an error, make a new entry referencing the original.
INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE: This value must be a positive number. The change has not been saved.
LAST_ADMINISTRATOR: This account cannot be deactivated or have the Administrator role removed: at least one active System Administrator is required.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many unsuccessful sign-in attempts. Your account is locked for {{minutes}} minutes. Contact your System Administrator if you need access sooner.
UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER: This template uses a placeholder that is not available for this event. Remove or correct {{placeholder}} before saving.
IMPORT_VALIDATION_FAILED: {{count}} row(s) failed validation. Download the report to see each error, or commit only the {{valid}} valid row(s).
_comment: Messages below are NOT worded in the SRS. They are listed in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md for supervisor approval.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is not correct.
ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This account has been deactivated. Contact your System Administrator.
INVALID_MFA_CODE: That code is not correct. Check the latest code and try again.
INVALID_RESET_CODE: This reset code is wrong, already used, or expired. Request a new one.
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Use at least 10 characters for the password.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this action.
NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your supervisor.
NOT_FOUND: This record could not be found.
INVALID_PHONE: Enter a valid Ghana phone number, for example 0244123456.
USERNAME_TAKEN: Another account already uses this username.
ROLE_REQUIRED: Give the account at least one role.
SOD_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED: Front Desk and Branch Manager together let one person take a payment and approve its refund. Record why this person needs both roles.
SOD_SAME_PERSON: You raised this request, so a different Branch Manager must decide it.
SOD_PAYMENT_CAPTURER: You captured a payment on this order, so a different Branch Manager must authorise this refund or adjustment.
SOD_CASHUP_CLOSER: You closed this cash-up, so a different Branch Manager must reconcile it.
INDEPENDENT_QC_REQUIRED: Independent QC is on: you completed this item's final stage, so another attendant must inspect it.
QC_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for the Fail outcome.
REWORK_LIMIT_REACHED: This item has reached the rework limit ({{limit}}). It has been sent to the Branch Manager for review instead of another rework.
EMPTY_BATCH: A batch cannot be started with zero items. Scan at least one item in first.
BATCH_ALREADY_STARTED: This batch has already started, so items can no longer be added or removed.
ITEM_NOT_READY_FOR_SORTING: This item is not waiting for sorting.
ITEM_NOT_READY_FOR_QC: This item has not finished processing, so it cannot be inspected yet.
ITEM_NOT_FAILED: Only an item with a Fail outcome can be overridden or discarded.
TAG_NOT_FOUND: No open item has this tag number. Check the tag and scan again.
TAG_NOT_ON_MANIFEST: This tag is not on this order's manifest.
SHELF_REQUIRED: Enter the shelf or location where the package will be kept.
ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE: This order has been finalised and can no longer be edited.
ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only Received or In Sorting orders can be cancelled.
CANCEL_REASON_REQUIRED: Choose a cancellation reason. For Other, add a note.
ORDER_NOT_READY: This order is not ready for this step yet.
ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: Payments cannot be taken on this order.
ORDER_ON_ACCOUNT: This order is billed to a corporate account and is paid through its monthly statement.
ORDER_ALREADY_ON_ROUTE: This order is already on another route.
ORDER_NOT_OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: This order is not out for delivery.
INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount greater than zero.
AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The amount is more than the balance due ({{balance}}).
TENDERED_TOO_LOW: The cash tendered is less than the amount being paid.
IDENTITY_REQUIRED: Record how the customer's identity was confirmed.
WEIGHT_REQUIRED: Enter the weight in kg for this per-kg service.
QUANTITY_REQUIRED: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
DELIVERY_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Enter a delivery address for a delivery order.
DISPOSAL_TOO_EARLY: This order can be disposed of only after {{required}} days; it has been {{days}} days.
ROUTE_NO_RIDER: Assign a rider to this route first.
ROUTE_EMPTY: Add at least one order before the route departs.
RECIPIENT_REQUIRED: Enter the name of the person who received the order.
FAILURE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason why the delivery failed.
ALREADY_DECIDED: This request has already been decided.
ALREADY_REQUESTED: A request is already waiting for the Branch Manager.
ADJUSTMENT_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: The adjustment is larger than the order total.
CASHUP_ALREADY_CLOSED: This cash-up has already been closed.
CASHUP_PENDING_REFERENCES: {{count}} card or mobile money payment(s) in this session still need a reference. Add them before closing.
CASHUP_NOT_FLAGGED: Only a flagged cash-up needs reconciling.
NOT_CORPORATE: This customer does not have a corporate account.
SLOT_IN_PAST: This time slot has already passed. Choose a later slot.
BOOKING_CUTOFF_PASSED: Bookings can be cancelled up to {{hours}} hours before the slot. Call the branch to change this one.
BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This booking can no longer be cancelled.
BOOKING_NOT_PICKUP: Only confirmed pickup bookings can be assigned to a rider.
BOOKING_NOT_CONVERTIBLE: This booking is already completed or cancelled.
CONSENT_REQUIRED: Agree to the privacy notice to create an account.
TRACK_NOT_FOUND: No order matches these details. Check the order number and the last 4 digits of the phone number.
STAGES_REQUIRED: Add at least one processing stage.
MACHINE_IN_USE: This machine is running a batch. Wait until the batch finishes.
INVALID_PERIOD: Choose a start date on or before the end date.
IMPORT_BAD_HEADER: The file is missing these columns: {{missing}}. Download the template and try again.
ALREADY_COMMITTED: This import has already been committed.
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many lookups in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Enter your pickup and delivery address.
STAGE_NOT_STARTED: Tap Start before Finish, so the time is recorded.
